name: Veresegyház (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Veresegyház: a white and blue shield with a red church and a bunch of grapes, with green mantling, above a red scroll inscribed VERESEGYHÁZ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Veresegyház arms with mantling and scroll
